FEDERAL ROADS(PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(CHERAS-KAJANG HIGHWAY) ORDER 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads (Private

Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Cheras-Kajang Highway) Order 2012.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 2 March 2012.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (Cheras-Kajang

Highway) 1999 [P.U. (A) 15/1999], which is referred to as the "principle Order" in this

Order, is amended in subparagraph 2(1)—

(a) by substituting for the words "1 January 2003 to 19 September 2027" the words

"2 March 2012 to 18 September 2045";

(b) by substituting for the words "Batu 9 Toll Plaza" the words "Batu 9 Toll Plaza

(Kajang bound)"; and

(c) by substituting for the words "Batu 11, Cheras Toll Plaza" the words "Batu 11,

Cheras Toll Plaza (Kuala Lumpur bound)".

Amendment of paragraph 3

3. The principle Order is amended in subparagraph 3(1)—

(a) by substituting for the words "Batu 9 Toll Plaza" the words "Batu 9 Toll Plaza

(Kajang bound)"; and

(b) by substituting for the words "Batu 11, Cheras Toll Plaza" the words "Batu 11,

Cheras Toll Plaza (Kuala Lumpur bound)".

Amendment of First Schedule

Schedule:

Classes of Vehicles

Class 1: Vehicles having two axles and three or four wheels

(excluding taxis and buses)

Class 2: Vehicles having two axles and five or six wheels (excluding buses)

Class 3: Vehicles having three axles or more (excluding buses)

Class 4: Taxis

Class 5: Buses

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles and

wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be included as part of the axles and

wheels of the vehicle.".
